title: Trump posts AI-edited photo to brag about White House restoration work
slides: Why is Trump posting AI-edited White House photos?
The image was altered before it reached the public
It shows restoration work that doesn't fully match reality
Every viral political image now needs a second look
Check the source before sharing any political image
thread_text:
1. The White House Photo That Isn't Real

Trump shared an AI-edited image of the Oval Office. The alteration happened before the public ever saw it.

2. Altered Before You Saw It

The edit wasn't a filter—it was a deliberate change to the scene. By the time it hit your feed, the damage was done.

3. Restoration Work vs. Reality

The image shows renovation work that doesn't match the actual state of the room. What's the gap between the picture and the truth?

4. Every Political Image Needs Doubt

Viral images now spread faster than fact-checks. Assume every share-worthy photo has been tweaked until proven otherwise.

5. Check the Source First

Before you share any political image, open the original post and verify the account. Does it hold up? If not, don't hit share.
